predictions.text: I predict that the film Sense and Sensibility is projected to gross $5–8 million in its opening weekend in the United States and Canada.
I predict that the film Whalefall will gross between $10 and $12 million from its theatrical release in the United States.

I predict that the Houthi–Saudi conflict will continue with more missile attacks on Saudi Arabian cities, including Riyadh and Dammam, resulting in at least 13 casualties and damaging 15 homes by the end of Friday, 23 October 2026.
I predict that the Russo-Ukrainian war will continue with another Russian strike against Ukrainian infrastructure, possibly targeting a merchant ship off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast.
I predict that in-person classes in Timor-Leste remain suspended for at least one more day, possibly until Saturday, 17 October 2026, due to poor air quality from wildfire smoke and pollutants.
I predict that the Strait of Hormuz will see at least one more attack on a ship, with Omani authorities conducting search-and-rescue operations for missing crew members.
I predict that the Sudanese Armed Forces will launch another airstrike at the Egypt-Sudan border, targeting an artisanal gold mine in a mountainous area, killing at least 72 people.

I predict that the Delhi Jantar Mantar protests will continue with more clashes between protesters and police, and at least two more remands in custody for protest leaders from different political parties.
I predict that the investigation into the 2026 Silver Rail Elementary School shooting will involve questioning at least three people by the end of Friday, 23 October 2026.

I predict that a prominent media organization will remain offline, with new administrators continuing to run the channel, and no significant changes in their management by the end of Friday, 23 October 2026.
